product_family: Multi-agent AI coding platform with IDE, CLI, API, and cloud execution. Supports Claude, Codex, Gemini, and proprietary Blackbox models with end-to-end encryption and zero data retention options.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II audit status is unclear: Nudge Security profile lists 'SOC 2 Compliant' but ToolChase's May 2026 review states 'No SOC 2 certification is publicly listed.' The company indicates 'interim audit letters available under NDA' via enterprise@blackbox.ai, suggesting audit in progress or not yet publicly released.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Claimed by Nudge Security profile as 'ISO 27001 Compliant' but no public verification, audit report, or dedicated documentation found on vendor domain. Status unclear: likely in progress or available under NDA only.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy Policy commits to an EU data-transfer safeguard: 'such as using Model Contractual Clauses for the European Union.' Note: the policy does not use the literal term 'GDPR'; this Model Contractual Clauses commitment is the vendor's only stated EU data-protection mechanism, and no GDPR data-subject-rights language was verifiable on the page.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No verifiable public evidence of HIPAA compliance on the vendor domain; the privacy policy does not mention HIPAA. Third-party/search summaries indicate 'HIPAA BAAs available on request' via enterprise@blackbox.ai, but this is not confirmed on a vendor-domain page.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: No verifiable public evidence of CCPA compliance on the vendor domain. The original claim was sourced from search results rather than a vendor-domain page, and the privacy policy does not mention CCPA.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Nudge Security profile lists 'PCI Compliant' but no public documentation or proof found on vendor domain. No vendor-domain evidence.

certifications.name: FedRamp
certifications.proof_quote: Nudge Security profile lists 'FedRamp Compliant' but no public FedRamp.gov listing or vendor documentation found. Likely incorrect attribution or aspirational claim.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: Nudge Security profile lists 'CSA Star Level 1 Compliant' but no CSA registry entry or vendor documentation found. Unverified claim.

privacy.ai_training_note: PRO tier: Privacy policy explicitly states 'If you are on the PRO version: zero data retention will be enabled, and none of your code will ever be stored or trained on.' Standard/free tiers: Policy indicates data is retained for the duration of Service access and used 'to provide and improve the Service,' suggesting standard tiers may permit processing but zero-training is not guaranteed. Enterprise 'never used for model training' language appears only in third-party/search summaries and is not confirmed on a vendor-domain page. AI training posture is tier-dependent and inconsistently documented.
privacy.data_region: Primary: United States. Privacy policy states 'Personal data processing occurs on our systems in the United States.' Enterprise options mentioned for EU data residency but not explicitly detailed.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS 1.3 with modern cipher suites and certificate pinning on mobile clients
security.source: https://www.blackbox.ai/security and search results for zero data retention

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES-256 with keys managed in AWS KMS with automatic rotation. Enterprise tier supports customer-managed keys (BYOK/CMK).

security.name: End-to-End Encryption
security.value: E2EE available for open-source models. Zero-knowledge architecture so 'even Blackbox infrastructure cannot read your content'. Premium and Enterprise tiers support E2E chat encryption.

security.name: Hardware Security
security.value: Confidential Computing via NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs with trusted execution environment (TEE). AES-256 encryption with keys generated and managed entirely within GPU chip.

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Zero Data Retention (ZDR) mode: Prompts, code context, completions processed in memory and discarded after response. Nothing written to disk or retained by Blackbox. Default on PRO+ plans.

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC). SSO via SAML 2.0 with Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, OneLogin. SCIM for automated user lifecycle.

security.name: Audit & Logging
security.value: Tamper-evident audit logs streamed to customer SIEM. Audit logging for compliance and security monitoring included in Enterprise tier.

security.name: Deployment Options
security.value: Dedicated VPC, on-premise deployment, fully air-gapped environments with no outbound internet. 99.9% uptime SLA for Enterprise.

security.name: Threat Protection
security.value: PII protection layer that 'strips and substitutes sensitive enterprise data before any request leaves our perimeter' for closed-source models.

products.name: Blackbox Free / Standard
products.data_scope: Data used for service improvement. Data residency: US. Encryption in transit (TLS 1.3). No explicit zero data retention guarantee on free tier.
products.notes: Freemium model. Claims 15+ million users. Features IDE plugin, VS Code extension, web interface.

products.name: Blackbox PRO
products.data_scope: PRO tier: 'Zero data retention' - no code stored or trained on. Privacy policy explicitly guarantees this tier has zero retention.
products.notes: Mid-tier with ZDR enabled by default. End-to-end encryption available. Includes desktop agent with E2E encryption.

products.name: Blackbox Enterprise
products.data_scope: Zero Data Retention enforced end-to-end. Private enclave processing. Data never used for model training. Audit trail with HIPAA-compliant processing. HIPAA BAAs available. Optional EU data residency.
products.notes: Full compliance suite. SAML SSO, SCIM, on-premise deployment, dedicated VPC, air-gapped options. Customer-managed encryption keys. 99.9% SLA, 24/7 support, named CSM. Confidential Computing via GPU attestation.

products.name: Blackbox API
products.data_scope: OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Multi-model support (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Grok, Blackbox). E2E encrypted by default. Zero data retention for Enterprise customers.
products.notes: Claims 60% faster output throughput vs direct OpenAI. Automatic multi-provider failover. WebSocket streaming. Zero-knowledge proxy architecture.

products.name: Blackbox CLI
products.data_scope: Agent execution from terminal. Multi-agent orchestration. E2E encryption for Enterprise tier.
products.notes: Dispatch competing agents in parallel. Automatic PR creation. CI/CD integration.

products.name: Blackbox Cloud Agents
products.data_scope: Always-on agent execution. E2E encryption available. ZDR on Enterprise plans.
products.notes: Supports all major agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, etc.). Chairman LLM evaluation for multi-agent workflows.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free tier) + PRO (monthly) + Enterprise (custom). API pricing: $0.45/M output tokens for encrypted E2E inference on Enterprise.
compare.data_residency: US primary. EU option available for Enterprise (details under NDA).

flags: Nudge Security profile lists SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, FedRamp, and CSA STAR as compliant, but only GDPR (via EU Model Contractual Clauses in the privacy policy) has verifiable vendor-domain evidence. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audit status is ambiguous: not publicly released per ToolChase (May 2026), but 'interim audit letters available under NDA' suggests audit in progress or restricted access.

No dedicated trust center or compliance documentation page exists on the vendor domain. Compliance details are scattered across the privacy policy, enterprise documentation, and blog posts. Direct contact with enterprise@blackbox.ai is required for audit reports, BAAs, DPAs, and detailed compliance status.

Privacy policy and documentation indicate different data handling across free, PRO, and Enterprise tiers. Standard/free tier training policy is ambiguous ('to provide and improve the Service') versus the PRO tier's explicit zero-retention guarantee. This creates potential confusion for customers about default data usage.

Interim audit letters 'available under NDA' mean compliance certifications cannot be independently verified without a signed agreement; Enterprise customers must sign agreements before certification evidence is shared.
Enterprise documentation mentions a 'full list of subprocessors available under NDA' but does not publicly state whether a standard Data Processing Agreement or DPA template is available.
HIPAA compliance is contingent on the Enterprise plan and BAA execution, not a platform-wide guarantee. Standard/PRO tiers do not mention HIPAA support.
